title: Use transport-specific display types for more port fields
description:
i.e., use FT_PT_UDP, FT_PT_TCP for some ports which are obviously
of that type.  This will allow the protocol name of port numbers
to be shown when transport name resolution is enabled.

notes.body: There are undoubtedly more fields that could be safely given a transport-specific display type.  I guess the value of this is that if an application offers what should be a standard/common port, that may now be more obvious.  Most of these fields are signalling ports for future conversations..

commits_data.message:
Use transport-specific display types for more port fields

i.e., use FT_PT_UDP, FT_PT_TCP for some ports which are obviously
of that type.  This will allow the protocol name of port numbers
to be shown when transport name resolution is enabled.
